messages:
Nadia: Heads-up: ran through the new sample-app quickstart and found a couple of copy/paste traps that will bite new users. Putting them here so we can patch the docs generator.

Lee: ok what's broken?

Nadia: 1) Docker example in sample-apps/docker/README.md uses env var REDWOODKEY (no underscore). 2) terraform example references REDWOOD_API_TOKEN. 3) the top-level Quickstart still says 'retries enabled by default' which isn't true for Python/Node.

Jordan: yikes. Docs generator likely pulled from three different snippets ages ago. Slight variable drift.

Nadia: Exact Docker snippet: 
```
ENV REDWOODKEY="changeme"
CMD ["node","index.js"]
```
Should be `REDWOOD_KEY`. Also Terraform section has: 
```
variable "redwood_token" { default = "${var.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN}" }
```

Nadia: These small mismatches cause two common support flows: 1) users copy Dockerfile and get 401s, 2) onboarding script fails because CLI looks for REDWOOD_KEY.

Lee: I'll open a docs PR to normalize to REDWOOD_KEY everywhere and add a one-line migration note for anyone using the older env names.

Sam: Can you also add a short callout near the top: "SDK retry behavior varies by language" with a link to SDK docs. That prevents users from assuming client-side retries exist in Node/Python.

Jordan: And while you're in there, add a tiny troubleshooting card named "Auth gotchas" listing common typos (REDWOODKEY vs REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_TOKEN) and the Docker env gotcha. Keeps support tickets down.

docs-bot: Created issue docs#901 "quickstart env var drift + retry callout" and added label docs/bug: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/901

Lee: PR 488 opened: fixes env var typos (Docker/Terraform/ curl examples), adds retry behavior callout and troubleshooting card. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/488

Nadia: Thanks. Can we also backport the fix to the onboarding repo template and the repo scaffolder used by the internal onboarding generator? That's where most new repos are created from.

Sam: I'll take the onboarding generator. Once PR 488 merges, I'll update the template and run a quick smoke test.

Jordan: FYI I scanned support logs and flagged three recent 401s that would've been closed faster if this doc change existed. Good catch.

Lee: Merged PR 488. Marking issue as resolved.

Sam: Backporting now to onboarding templates and regenerated a sample repo. Verified Docker quickstart and terraform sample both work with REDWOOD_KEY.

Nadia: Verified locally too. Thanks team! We'll include a short note in the weekly docs sync to remind maintainers about env var canonicalization. :sparkles:
